test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 16 May, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A car left 4 hours later than the scheduled time but in order to reach its destination 480 km away in time, it had to increase its usual speed by 10 km/hr. What is the usual speed of the car?
solution:
**Detailed solution:-**

Let the usual speed of the car be ‘x’ km/hr.

Time is taken to cover 480 km = Distance/Speed = 480/x hrs.

But, when the car left 4 hours left, the Speed of the car = (x + 10) km/hr.

⇒ Time taken = Distance/Speed = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480/x) - 4 = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480- 4x)/x = 480/(x + 10)

⇒ (480 - 4x)(x + 10) = 480x

⇒ 480x + 4800 - 4x² - 40x = 480x

 

⇒ 4x² + 40x - 4800 = 0 

⇒ x² + 10x - 1200 = 0 

⇒ x2 + 40x - 30x - 1200 = 0

⇒ x(x + 40) - 30(x + 40) = 0

⇒ (x + 40)(x - 30) = 0

⇒ x = -40, 30 

∵ Speed cannot be negative 

**∴ The required answer is __30__. 

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Distance = (X × Y)/(X - Y) [time difference]

⇒ [x × (x + 10)/10] × 4 = 480

⇒ x(x + 10) = 1200

⇒ x × (x + 10) = 30 × 40

⇒ x = 30 km/hr
